notes.title: New Trailer Reveals Nemesis Vega, Updated Steam Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Fight, dodge, survive. A brutal yet charming celebration you won’t forget.

World Eater Games and DANGEN Entertainment are excited to reveal a brand-new trailer for Bittersweet Birthday, the highly anticipated story-driven action RPG where every fight is a boss fight. The new trailer highlights Vega, one of the game’s nemeses, offering players a deeper glimpse into the mystery, tension, and unforgettable encounters that define the adventure.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WSwuuJOnWy4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
A newly updated demo for Bittersweet Birthday is now available on Steam. The demo features new content and improvements that showcase the game’s challenging boss battles, exploration, and heartfelt storytelling. Players can download the demo and experience its unique blend of brutal challenge and charm right now.


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593480/Bittersweet_Birthday_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][b]About Bittersweet Birthday[/b]

Bittersweet Birthday is a story-driven action RPG where every battle is a boss fight, each one a unique, challenging test that blends “Souls-like precision” with bullet hell chaos. Survival means mastering enemy patterns, timing your dodges, and striking with precision in battles that demand both patience and nerve.

Outside combat, you’ll explore a bustling town, uncover secrets, complete side quests, and collect mementos that shape your fighting style. Packed with an eccentric cast of characters, nostalgic pixel art, quirky mini-games, and even collectible gachapon, Bittersweet Birthday offers a blend of punishing challenge and heartfelt charm unlike anything else.

[b]STORY[/b]
You awaken without memories, disoriented and alone, until a mysterious voice over a speaker offers you a way out. Hunted by unstable pursuers, your only chance at survival is to follow its cryptic guidance.

Along the way, you’ll piece together fragments of a past scarred by trauma, confront truths better left forgotten, and discover why the path forward leads to one unavoidable destination: your birthday party.

Bittersweet Birthday is scheduled to release later this year on PC platforms, with Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S releases planned for a later date. Exact release dates will be announced soon![/p]

notes.title: Release Date Window and Some Cool News!!
notes.notes:
Hey all! Besides Media Indie Exchange’s Guerilla Collective, we’ve also just made an appearance at the Summer Game Fest during the Latin American Games Showcase event!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9dFEMIW.png[/img]

And with this, we make the official announcement that we’re working with Dangen Entertainment! They will be in charge of publishing Bittersweet Birthday on all platforms as well as translating the game into Spanish and Japanese, and countless other things that let put all our energy and focus into making an awesome game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/59RDhGn.jpeg[/img]


Bittersweet Birthday will release Q2 of 2025! For those who just heard of us, there’s a demo available for you to play, and even if you’ve been here for a while you might want to check it out again and see how things are coming along!
And finally, here’s a new trailer to look at in case you missed the events.


[previewyoutube=ve53cyTDuvQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bittersweet Birthday brings a mix of a boss-rush adventure with exploration
notes.notes:
Now crowdfunding on IndieGoGo with a demo available, Bittersweet Birthday is a very promising atmospheric adventure that mixed in plenty of boss battles and an intriguing story about being hunted.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/bittersweet-birthday-brings-a-mix-of-a-boss-rush-adventure-with-exploration

notes.title: At last, a campaign launch date!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, after a lot of time, planning and organization (and don't forget the tears 🥲), we have some big announcements to make:

Our Indiegogo campaign will launch on: [b] 🎉🎉AUGUST 9🎉🎉!!![/b]

And you know what this means: an updated demo will come out on august 9 as well 🎉 (cue the smaller, but no less powerful party popper).

The second (and no less important announcement) is:

[b]THE DEMO WILL BE TRANSLATED TO SPANISH!!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40159473/ddc2f1c8c2f0edd3926069d318908d059ae0ab8c.png[/img]

We'd like to thank everyone who has helped us get this far!! We're hopeful that the campaign will be a success and we'll be able to bring the full game to life~

And as a final note, you can help us spread the word by sharing the campaign, the game, or just by telling your friends to give the game a try!

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/bittersweet-birthday-a-game-of-heart-horror--2/coming_soon/x/22254511]You can find the pre-launch page over here![/url]

Thanks again for everything, and hopefully we'll be seeing each other on a couple of days 🙏
